# DuckDB libpg_query raw-core manifest

This directory is the exact minimal raw-parser subset selected by DB M8.2.
It originates from DuckDB `v1.5.5`, commit
`d8cdaa33fda8df955cc76ef58a280f68f4cd43fa`:

- archive: `https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/archive/refs/tags/v1.5.5.tar.gz`;
- archive SHA-256:
  `f33155ff962e6e1e08fd1e9caffa487d4325aa60999e2eabc76feff534d6558b`;
- upstream subtree: `third_party/libpg_query`;
- upstream full subtree path-list SHA-256:
  `0b2c3ebe5b6060a6918606672e6087a37892db19d994b45c13bcf39a7e5fa10d`;
- upstream C/C++ source/header path-list SHA-256:
  `3283e4cc7d301628f185911bbf3b8c3fea915c0530d13956c3d22002ab0f9f73`.

The 126 direct copies are the nine upstream raw-core translation units, their
needed headers (excluding `include/postgres_parser.hpp`), scanner and grammar
inputs/generated outputs, and the three upstream generation helpers. Their
retained path-list SHA-256 is:

```text
31a6f59b701f674f3068983b04a51da2e20b7404fc44ed9455c97061aaec3009
```

Together with this DB-owned `UPSTREAM.md` and `CMakeLists.txt`, the
directory contains 128 files. Those two integration files are intentionally
outside the direct-copy path-list hash.

The retained include-file path list has SHA-256
`d637f859b1a5db6ef13e689d12f840f41b71f01b4575669d44077bc625a3d968`;
the retained grammar-file path list has SHA-256
`9875c5e1c2c6f9e0f327c83527f528017ae8abb6256fb8b11b9800d0259207ed`.

Excluded upstream files are `postgres_parser.cpp`,
`include/postgres_parser.hpp`, and the upstream CMake glue. The excluded
wrapper imports `duckdb/common/vector.hpp`; DB calls only the raw C++
parser API through its private adapter. DuckDB database code is not retained.

`LICENSE` is the retained BSD 3-Clause license and must remain with all source
and binary redistributions. No first-party source is generated by this
directory at normal build time. The checked-in `src_backend_parser_gram.cpp`,
`include/parser/gram.hpp`, and `src_backend_parser_scan.cpp` are the generated
outputs used by the offline build.

## Reproduction and verification

The generation helpers are copied from DuckDB's top-level `scripts/` because
the upstream README's relative commands assume that source-tree layout. They
are retained as `tools/generate_grammar.py`, `tools/generate_flex.py`, and
`tools/python_helpers.py`. Regeneration requires the old upstream-compatible
flex/bison toolchain documented in `README.md`; it is an explicit maintenance
operation, not a normal CMake dependency. A maintainer must generate in a clean
DuckDB `v1.5.5` checkout or adjust only the path prefix/namespace parameters,
then compare the resulting checked-in files and update this manifest after
review. The normal server image intentionally has no flex or bison.

The following direct-copy hashes cover every retained root source and helper;
the remaining retained headers/grammar files are covered by the path-list
hashes above and their source archive pin.
